english.title: Operate emergency stop etc at Manchester Airport other than in emergency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), except in the case of an emergency, intentionally operated a

(A)_[switch]_
(B)_[lever]_

on

(C)_[an escalator]_
(D)_[a travelator]_
(E)_[a tracked transit system]_
(F)_[a lift]_
(G)_[an automatic conveyance for passengers, namely **(..SPECIFY CONVEYANCE..)]_
(H)_[fuel hydrant equipment]_

at Manchester Airport near to which a sign was displayed which stated that it was only to be operated in case of emergency
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 3.23 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
